body: هل يستطيع الإسبان السير على خطى البرازيل؟ لم تكد إسبانيا ترفع كأس العالم 2026 بعد فوزها على الأرجنتين في النهائي، حتى بدأ الحديث حول قدرة الجيل الحالي المبهر على اجتياز تحد تاريخي لم يقدر عليه كثير من الأبطال الموندياليين. فالمنتخب الإسباني يحلم بالدفاع بنجاح عن لقب كأس العالم، وهو إنجاز لم يتحقق منذ أكثر من ستة عقود، وهو أمر قد يرتبط أيضًا بمعركة أخرى مع المغرب لا تقل أهمية. لعنة صمدت منذ 1962 بالنظر للتاريخ نجد أنه لا يمنح إسبانيا الكثير من الطمأنينة، فآخر منتخب نجح في الاحتفاظ بلقب كأس العالم كان البرازيل، بعدما توج بنسختي 1958 و1962، وقبلها كانت إيطاليا أول من حقق الإنجاز بالفوز بلقبي 1934 و1938. ومنذ ذلك الحين، تحولت مهمة الدفاع عن اللقب إلى واحدة من أصعب التحديات في كرة القدم العالمية. الأرجنتين اقتربت في مونديال 1990، بعدما وصلت إلى النهائي بقيادة دييجو مارادونا وهي تحمل لقب 1986، لكنها خسرت أمام ألمانيا الغربية. ثم جاءت البرازيل في 1998، وبلغت النهائي وهي بطلة نسخة 1994، قبل أن تسقط أمام فرنسا بثلاثية نظيفة. وفي قطر 2022، كانت فرنسا على بعد مباراة واحدة من دخول التاريخ، بعدما بلغت النهائي وهي حاملة لقب 2018، لكنها خسرت أمام الأرجنتين بركلات الترجيح بعد واحد من أعظم النهائيات في تاريخ البطولة. أما الأرجنتين، التي حملت لقب 2022، فقد كررت السيناريو في مونديال 2026، ووصلت إلى …

title: Steam may be celebrating the railway experience with its Train Fest, but let's remember how rubbish the typical train trip is with some Train Sim World DLC
summary: "The grey, misty gloom streaking past me is authentically British."
body: (Image credit: Dovetail Games) I've taken the train from Bath to London hundreds of times in my life, usually to visit game developers in the capital. And while I enjoy that part of the job, the journey itself is a dispiriting chore. Rail travel in the United Kingdom is a chaos of delays, overcrowding and overpriced sandwiches. Yet when I saw Great Western Express on Steam—an expansion for Train Sim World that recreates part of that route—I felt compelled to play it. Videogames are a powerful form of escapism for me, but what if I played one to achieve the complete opposite of that? Train Sim World is primarily a game about driving trains, but it's unique in that it also lets you be a passenger. Bath isn't in the game yet, so I start my journey at Reading, and I'm immediately struck by how well they've recreated the station. I've spent many hours here over the years waiting for delayed connections, and the layout is perfect—although the lack of a pasty shop is jarring. The pasty is a station staple, and I will forever associate the smell of hot pastry with waiting for trains. title: A classic Giger-inspired adventure game just got a sequel
summary: Tormentum 2 is out now.
body: H. R. Giger's biomechanical nightmares have inspired plenty of videogames. If we go way back, his work was repurposed for baffling puzzle adventure Dark Seed , and more recently there was the fleshy horror of Scorn . Tormentum: Dark Sorrow was more in the vein of the former than the latter, a point-and-click adventure that took Giger's stylings (and those of Zdzisław Beksiński too) as inspiration for its hand-painted horrors. A full 11 years after its release, and after eight years of development, Tormentum finally has a sequel. Tormentum 2 is a standalone game though, just one in a similar style, which is to say that it's full of bones and alien faces and naked people who are embedded in walls. In Tormentum 2 you're trapped inside a simulated world that's got out of hand, the supposedly digital characters within suddenly out of control and talking about gods from distant places. You have to cross the islands that make up this world, solving puzzles as you go, and working your way toward one of multiple endings. body: This year's Gen Con event is one Wizards of the Coast has said it's "pulling out all the stops for", with a keynote to be hosted by Theo Solomon (who played Wyll in Baldur's Gate 3) including a bunch of announcements about what's coming up for Dungeons & Dragons. One release seems to have been leaked early: a crossover with World of Warcraft. According to a news post on virtual tabletop Roll20 that has since been removed (you can find it on RPG site EN World ), we can expect Warcraft to get at least a setting book for D&D 5th edition, as a couple of Magic: The Gathering worlds have previously. This wouldn't be the first collaboration between Blizzard and D&D. Around the time of Diablo 2 there were several official books by Wizards of the Coast adapting the world of Sanctuary to D&D's rules. title: Videogame villains who sing at you are the best
summary: The Devil has all the best tunes. But GLaDOS has some good ones too.
body: Villains monologue at us so much in videogames it's become passe. Oh, you're so evil you took over the radio station and replaced the friendly voice that's been guiding me since the tutorial just so you can tell me about your evil plan? Yawn. Use that radio to sing a song at me, maybe then I'll pay attention. Sing during a boss fight and I'll pay even more attention. I'm not sure where this trend started, but the videogame boss who is so extra they can't help but perform an entire song-and-dance routine while kicking your ass has become a delightful trend—though not all the entries on this list are boss-fight songs. If it happened too often it would stop being surprising and lose all its power. Which is also why games that are entirely musical don't count for the purpose of this list. You won't find Stray Gods, Billie Bust Up, Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure, No Straight Roads, People of Note, or Mortimer and the Riddles of the Medallion here. Only unexpected songs count, which is why you shouldn't read this list if you don't want their existence spoiled for you. title: صحفي فرنسي عن ديوماندي: سأشعر أنني أحمق لو كنت مشجعًا لريال مدريد
summary: الميرينجي مُطالب بدفع الكثير من الأموال لأجل ديوماندي
body: الميرينجي مُطالب بدفع الكثير من الأموال لأجل ديوماندي انتقد الصحفي الفرنسي، وليد أشرشور، ما يتردد عن سعي ريال مدريد للتعاقد مع الجناح الإيفواري الشاب، يان ديوماندي، معتبرًا أن الصفقة المحتملة لا ترقى إلى مستوى التوقعات، خاصةً إذا جاءت لتعويض فينيسيوس جونيور أو مايكل أوليسي. وخلال ظهوره في برنامج "After Foot" عبر إذاعة "RMC" الفرنسية، قال أشرشور مساء اليوم السبت: "إذا كنت من مشجعي ريال مدريد، فإن الانتقال من أوليسي مقابل 150 مليون يورو إلى ديوماندي مقابل 120 مليون يورو، فسأقول إن هناك شخصًا ما أخذني على أنني أحمق. هناك خطأ في البضاعة". اقرأ أيضًا ريال مدريد يحدد موعد تقديم أحدث صفقاته رودري يبلغ مانشستر سيتي بموقفه من الانتقال إلى ريال مدريد وأضاف أن مثل هذه الصفقات قد تبدو غير منطقية بالنسبة لجماهير النادي الملكي، خاصة عندما يتم إنفاق مبالغ ضخمة على لاعبين لا يملكون بعد الضمانات الكافية للوصول إلى المستوى المنتظر في ريال مدريد. ويأتي تعليق أشرشور، في ظل التقارير التي تربط ريال مدريد بالتعاقد مع جناح لايبزيج، يان ديوماندي، بينما لا يزال مستقبل فينيسيوس جونيور محل جدل، مع استمرار تعثر مفاوضات تجديد عقده، الذي ينتهي في صيف 2027. وكان الصحفي الألماني، فلوريان بليتينبرج، قد ذكر أن الميرينجي بات يتفوق على باريس سان جيرمان في السباق نحو ديوماندي، فيما جرت اتصالات جديدة بين الأطراف اليوم.…

title: Games industry analyst says Meccha Chameleon's June revenue on PC was second only to Fortnite
summary: It's the perfect business stratagem: first you Meccha game, then you Meccha lot of money.
body: They say money can't buy happiness, so I guess Meccha Chameleon creators lemorion_1224 and Haganeiro will have to get a yacht instead. Much has been said about the ludicrous success of the hide-and-seek game, but a recent figure from Newzoo (shared by GamesIndustry.biz ) further puts things into perspective: for June revenue on PC in a handful of western countries, it came second only to Fortnite. Newzoo analyst Mert Şahin told GamesIndustry.biz that the game's sudden and huge success "shows that lower-budget, socially driven multiplayer experiences can achieve significant commercial results." The game's low barrier to entry, both price and spec-wise, alongside all the viral popularity it experienced on social media sites like YouTube, certainly helped it along. The full list offers the top 20 games by revenue in the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain, and Italy, and after Meccha Chameleon comes Counter-Strike 2, Valorant, and League of Legends. title: Final Fantasy 14 has finally added the class I'm always asking for: a Viking with two shields, laser cannons, and Wolverine claws
summary: Straight from my middle school sketchbooks.
body: Fantasy RPGs have become too comfortable with delivering the expected gaggle of familiar character concepts. Archers, monks, paladins, you know the drill. I've seen it all before! Give me, I don't know, a Viking that shoots triple-barreled laser guns out of its dual shields, which also have metal claws, you know? Final Fantasy 14 knows what I'm talking about—down to the last detail, in fact. Indeed, the first new job to be introduced as part of the Evercold is just that: the bastion, a main tank that blocks, shoots, and stabs all with the same instrument. Those dual weapons, "known as skyltborg," seem to be entirely new to the Final Fantasy setting, though they are reminiscent of Rhitahtyn Arvina 's supersized gunshields. Granted, most of my experience with that setting is through Kingdom Hearts, but I know I would have remembered if Mickey Mouse picked a pair of these up at any point. The teaser trailer shows off some of its combat animations, and as is FF14 tradition, they're extravagant and accompanied by some badass electronic rock. title: One excellent, unforgettable expansion has fixed Doom: The Dark Ages
summary: Revelations singlehandedly redeems the low point of the trilogy.
body: I liked Doom: The Dark Ages when it arrived last year, but I really ought to have loved it.
